title: Mr. Sandman · the mouth quartet
description: The complete song with its original words, sung by bass, tenor, alto and soprano. Four simulated mouths supply every melody, close harmony, bum-bum passage and playful response.

melody.name: Bass
melody.lyrics: Bum Yes Mr. Sandman, bring me a dream Make him the cutest that I've ever seen Give him two lips like roses and clover Then tell him that his lonesome nights are over Sandman, I'm so alone Don't have nobody to call my own Please turn on your magic beam Mr. Sandman, bring me a dream Mr. Sandman, bring me a dream Make him the cutest that I've ever seen Give him the word that I'm not a rover Then tell him that his lonesome nights are over Sandman, I'm so alone, don't have nobody to call my own. Please turn on your magic beam, Mr. Sandman, bring me a dream. Mr. Sandman, bring us a dream. Give him a pair of eyes with a come hither gleam Give him a lonely heart like Pagliacci And lots of wavy hair like Liberace Mr. Sandman, someone to hold Someone to hold Would be so peachy before we're too old So please turn on your magic beam Mr. Sandman, bring us! Please, please, please, Mr. Sandman, bring us a dream!
melody.source: Original words transcribed from the user-supplied Chordettes recording; SATB notes adapted from the locally saved F. Montero reference, transposed down one semitone.
